name: CaseGridGapRowColumn
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "grid-gap-row-column" (grid-gaps). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: row-gap: 8px; column-gap: 16px (distinct values)
